name: muOS
notes: core.json lists no extensions. The skip.ini globs are matched lowercased with fnmatch (fe common/base/strutil.c:31-104), and every other file is listed.

A folder gets its core when its name, lowercased without space, '-', '_' and '+', is one of a system's friendly names (fe common/content/core/common.c:396-398). assign.json is built from every friendly name (os script/system/assign.sh:65-80).
The roms root is ROMS on the card that holds MUOS/bios, or /mnt/sdcard/ROMS on the second card. RetroArch sees the BIOS folder as /run/muos/storage/bios.

fe.note: newest frontend commit at or before the internal pin date
